title: Ordinary restriction and degree-zero coefficient comparison
statement: For a compatible algebra coefficient square over a ringed geometric pullback whose two structural coefficient maps are isomorphisms, there are natural ordinary restriction and coefficient-module isomorphisms with precisely the parent generator equations.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: Identify each pullback with its algebraic inverse image followed by restriction along the inverse structural coefficient. The comparison inserts one and its inverse multiplies scalars.

Transport module operations across the inverse-image underlying isomorphisms. Compatibility of the ring square makes the resulting underlying identity linear after restriction and gives a natural isomorphism. Cancel the two inverse-image module identifications to verify the generator formula.
Apply restriction comparison to the regular coefficient module and the inverse-image unit-object comparison. Its underlying ring identification gives the degree-zero coefficient generator formula.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.

theorem coefficient_iso
    (f : RingedPullback.{u, u, u, u, u} R S)
    (k : Comparison.{u, u, u, u, u} f)
    (d : CoefficientSquare.{u, u, u, u, u} f)
    (k' : Comparison.{u, u, u, u, u} (changed f d))
    [IsIso f.coefficient] [IsIso d.coefficient'] :
    ∃ β : f.L.obj (coefficient d.sourceMap) ≅ coefficient d.targetMap,
      ∀ (Z : Sheaf K (Type u))
        (x : Z ⟶ (underlying.{u, u, u} R).obj (coefficient d.sourceMap)),
        generator f k x ≫ (underlying.{u, u, u} S).map β.hom =
          f.uInv.map x ≫ d.I'.ringUnderlying.hom ≫
            (sheafCompose L (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map d.coefficient'
